content: ## Metadata_Start ## code: en ## title: Messaging App Is Not Configured ## slug: msg-ss-messaging-app-not-configured ## seoTitle: Messaging App Is Not Configured ## description: ## contentType: Markdown ## Metadata_End ### Scheduler Admin When the Messaging App is not configured on a Global Scheduler after installation, a warning message tells the user to configure their Messaging Account. ![MessagingAppNotConfigured_1](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/MessagingAppNotConfigured_1.jpg){height="" width=""} The same warning message also appears on the Record Level. ![MessagingAppNotConfigured_2](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/MessagingAppNotConfigured_2.jpg){height="" width=""} ### Scheduler User The Scheduler User does not have access to the Administration Settings. When they land on the Record Level Scheduler, a warning message tells them to contact the System Administrator. ![MessagingAppNotConfigured_3](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/MessagingAppNotConfigured_3.jpg){height="" width=""}
